positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
Solo creating and maintaining, both front and back, Google Map based apps that work on both IOS and Android platforms to help carriers deliver in the most efficient way (up to 1000 addresses), access delivery details and navigation in real time.

One of the biggest achievement was successfully implementing a function which takes in a list of addresses and return an optimal Hamiltonian path by using a self-implemented distance matrix to reduce operating cost, given how expensive distance matrix API is in the current market.

Skills: Android/ IOS app development, Backend development, Service development, Big data processing.
